title: A merchant buy-down fee adjustment debits DEFERRED_INCOME_LIABILITY 22 1000 then credits BUY_DOWN_EXPENSE 23 1000 (loan 14 L511)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the TWO-LEG journal entry a BUY_DOWN_FEE_ADJUSTMENT transaction posts on a MERCHANT buy-down product, on the Tier-D MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits, product LP2_PROGRESSIVE_ADVANCED_PAYMENT_ALLOCATION_BUYDOWN_FEES, merchantBuyDownFee true) at the buy-down-fee-adjustment transaction L511. request.buy_down_fee_adjustment_journal.amount transcribes the loan read-back's buyDownFeeAdjustment transaction id 511: amount 10.000000 -> "1000" minor units. request.buy_down_fee_adjustment_journal.merchant is the read-back's top-level merchantBuyDownFee true. request.buy_down_fee_adjustment_journal.accounts is the product's slot->GL-account-id mapping read back from the accepted create request create-request-LP2_PROGRESSIVE_ADVANCED_PAYMENT_ALLOCATION_BUYDOWN_FEES.json: fundSourceAccountId 5, buyDownExpenseAccountId 23, deferredIncomeLiabilityAccountId 22; the product's ONLY channel mapping is paymentTypeId 1 -> 17 and the adjustment was posted with paymentTypeId 5, which has no channel mapping, so the default FUND_SOURCE 5 applies (unused on this merchant leg). expect.buy_down_fee_adjustment_journal_legs is a TRANSCRIPTION of the two L511 legs in id order from the journal-entries sweep: id 1074 entryType DEBIT glAccountId 22 amount 10.0 and id 1075 CREDIT glAccountId 23 amount 10.0. The adjustment is the mirror of the buy-down fee: the Java local is named debitAccountType but is passed as the CREDITED account, and the helper's parameter order is (accountTypeToBeDebited, accountTypeToBeCredited), so the deferred-income-liability debit comes first and the merchant-selected buy-down expense account is credited. THIS VECTOR GRADES ONE PROPERTY: when the product's merchantBuyDownFee is set the buy-down-fee-adjustment credit posts to the buy-down expense account rather than the resolved fund source, and the debit posts to deferred income liability. THIS MERCHANT OBSERVATION IS A CONTROL for the ignore-merchant drive: a port that always credits the buy-down expense account posts the SAME legs here, and it is the non-merchant siblings that move the credit account. WHAT THIS VECTOR DOES NOT GRADE: the non-merchant fund-source credit (sibling vectors). Nothing was computed by this promotion: every amount, every account and every expected leg is read directly from the committed files.
